questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ lies on a smooth horizontal table. It is connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth pulley at the edge of the table to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest with the string taut.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the system and find the tension in the string.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $4\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table where the coefficient of friction is $0.25$. A light inextensible string attached to $A$ passes over a smooth pulley at the table edge to a vertically hanging particle $B$ of mass $6\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system and the tension in the string.

questions.prompt: A block $P$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is on a smooth plane inclined at an angle of $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Block $P$ is attached to a light inextensible string that passes over a smooth pulley at the top of the incline to a hanging particle $Q$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the acceleration of $P$ and find the tension in the string.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ on a horizontal table is connected by a light taut string passing over a smooth pulley at the edge of the table to a hanging particle $B$. During the motion, the tension in the string is $15\text{ N}$. One section of the string is horizontal and the other is vertical.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the magnitude of the resultant force exerted by the string on the pulley, and state the angle this force makes with the horizontal.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is on a rough horizontal table. It is connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth pulley at the table edge to a hanging mass of $3\text{ kg}$. When the system is released from rest, it accelerates at $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension in the string and determine the coefficient of friction $\mu$ between the block and the table.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $M\text{ kg}$ on a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal is connected via a light inextensible string over a smooth pulley at the top of the plane to a hanging particle of mass $4\text{ kg}$. When released from rest, the hanging particle descends with an acceleration of $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the tension in the string and determine the value of $M$.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $1.6\text{ kg}$ rests on a smooth horizontal table. It is attached to a light inextensible string which passes over a smooth pulley at the edge of the table to a particle $B$ of mass $2.4\text{ kg}$ hanging vertically. The system is held at rest and then released.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system and the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Particle $B$ is initially $1.2\text{ m}$ above the floor. Block $A$ is sufficiently far from the pulley that it does not reach the pulley during the motion. Calculate the speed of $B$ immediately before it hits the floor and the time taken for $B$ to reach the floor.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ lies on a rough horizontal table where the coefficient of friction is $0.20$. A light inextensible string connects $A$ to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ over a smooth light pulley fixed at the table edge. The string segment on the table is horizontal.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the magnitude of the frictional force acting on $A$ while sliding is $6\text{ N}$, and find the acceleration of the system.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the tension in the string during motion, and find the magnitude of the force exerted by the string on the pulley.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ lies on a rough plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the plane is $0.20$. A light inextensible string attached to $A$ runs parallel to the line of greatest slope, passes over a smooth pulley at the top of the plane, and supports a freely hanging particle $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Determine the direction of motion of particle $A$, and calculate the acceleration of the system and the tension in the string, giving each value to $3$ significant figures.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the speed of $A$ after moving a distance of $0.6\text{ m}$ up the plane from rest, giving your answer to $3$ significant figures.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $4\text{ kg}$ is on a smooth plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.6$ and $\cos\theta = 0.8$. A light inextensible string attached to $A$ passes over a smooth pulley at the top of the incline to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $1\text{ kg}$. In addition, a constant force of magnitude $X\text{ N}$ acts on $A$ directed down the plane parallel to the line of greatest slope. The system accelerates down the plane with an acceleration of $1.2\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the tension in the string and determine the value of $X$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: If the system starts from rest, calculate the distance block $A$ travels down the plane in the first $2.5\text{ s}$ and find the speed of $A$ at that instant.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table where $\mu = 0.20$. A light inextensible string connects $A$ over a smooth pulley at the table edge to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$. Particle $B$ is initially $1.0\text{ m}$ above the floor. The system is released from rest. When $B$ hits the floor, it does not rebound, and the string immediately becomes slack.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that while the string is taut, the acceleration of the system is $2.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and find the speed of block $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the floor.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the deceleration of block $A$ after the string becomes slack, and calculate the total distance block $A$ moves from release until coming to rest, assuming it does not reach the pulley.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ of mass $1\text{ kg}$ is on a rough plane inclined at an angle $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = \frac{3}{5}$ and $\cos\alpha = \frac{4}{5}$. The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the plane is $\frac{1}{4}$. A light inextensible string connects $A$ to a particle $B$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ hanging vertically, passing over a smooth pulley at the top of the incline. The string is parallel to the line of greatest slope. The system is released from rest when $B$ is $0.9\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. When $B$ strikes the ground, it remains at rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the system while $B$ is descending is $4\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and calculate the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ strikes the ground, and find the deceleration of $A$ while moving further up the plane after the string becomes slack.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Calculate the additional distance $A$ moves up the plane before coming momentarily to rest, and deduce the total distance moved by $A$ from release.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table at a distance of $3.5\text{ m}$ from a smooth light pulley fixed at the table edge. Block $A$ is connected by a light inextensible string passing over the pulley to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $m\text{ kg}$. The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the table is $0.25$. The system is released from rest with the string taut, and $B$ descends a distance of $0.8\text{ m}$ before hitting the floor. During this stage, the acceleration of the system is $2.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the tension in the string during the first stage of motion and determine the value of the hanging mass $m$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the force exerted by the string on the pulley while the string is taut, and calculate the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the floor.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: After $B$ hits the floor, the string becomes slack and $B$ does not rebound. Show that block $A$ comes to rest before reaching the pulley, and find the total time elapsed from release until block $A$ comes to rest.
